formation_structure.artillery_accountability: Count only damage actually dealt to the artillery. Roadblock damage, ground-enemy damage and elapsed time do not establish artillery clearance. The proposed late reinforcements do not provide a verified 13000-HP damage budget.

economy.basis: Initial 10 DP, natural recovery, observed Fang automatic grants, and refunds from successful retreats.
economy.conditions: Ledger assumes Fang's supported deployment cost reduction, grants at frames 570, 1320 and 2070, Beagle's successful nine-DP retreat, Lancet's successful one-DP retreat, and GALLUS's successful one-DP retreat. A death invalidates the corresponding grant or refund and rejects dependent actions.
economy.later_actions: Later reinforcement frames are review checkpoints with explicit funding and survival preconditions; they are not a verified affordable continuation.

formation_structure.medical_geometry: Ansel LEFT at [5,5] ordinarily covers lower central [4,3], lower outer [6,4], and Durin [5,3]. Hibiscus RIGHT at [2,3] ordinarily covers upper central [3,5], upper outer [1,4], and Steward [2,5]. GALLUS [2,7] has no ordinary professional healing coverage.
formation_structure.opening_geometry: Fang [3,5] and Beagle [4,3] are separated by sqrt(5) tiles. GALLUS [2,7] is sqrt(5) from Fang. Lancet [5,5] is sqrt(5) from Beagle and sqrt(8) from Friston [6,3]. These placements replace the failed opening geometry.
formation_structure.slots: Maximum eight simultaneous deployments. Clearance units and temporary blockers must leave before their successors enter. No ninth deployment is authorized.

formation_transitions.transition: Delay Lancet's deployment recovery until the lower defender has meaningful missing HP; ordinary lower healing then begins.
Exchange Beagle for a fresh Noir Corne at the lower choke. This requires Beagle to remain alive through the exchange.
Replace Lancet with Ansel on the same tile, retreat first.
Withdraw the unhealed eastern upper caster before relying on it through the eastern artillery visit. Upper eastern roadblock clearance must already have been observed.
Observe Fang's automatic grant before replacing her with Cardigan. No further Fang income is budgeted.
Begin the clearance and damage reinforcement review. Funding, live blockers and eight-slot legality must be established before any continuation is accepted.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator belongs to the supplied normal-mode catalog and has identity.rarity between 1 and 3.
Fang, Beagle and their support must remain alive until their specified grants or handoffs. Failed survival is not repaired by assuming income or refunds.

The opening uses sqrt(5) or greater separation between the designated shell absorber and its indispensable support. Later adjacent caster placement requires separate splash validation and is not presumed safe.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Observe roadblock destruction and safe arrivals; officer interception must not leave a detained civilian within the officer's 1.2 attack radius.
Require actual DP, a living retreat source, a free deployment slot and a legal cooldown before each exchange. No automatic waiting or tactical substitution is implied by a failed precondition.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two protected targets safely arrived. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Maintain four interceptions, preserve Fang through two income events, establish delayed lower recovery, and execute the defender bridge.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: A missing live blocker, grant or refund invalidates the opening and downstream economy.

pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Do not treat professional medic deployment as proof that all injured units receive sufficient healing.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Complete all remaining roadblock duties, protect both civilians and destroy the artillery before its approximate modeled exit.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: The candidate fails if its unverified clearance and artillery damage budgets cannot meet these obligations.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Preserve four corridors through the final spawn at frame 6330, then clear all remaining enemies.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Any leak, protected-target death or missing safe arrival rejects project acceptance.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic six-DP grants are expected after 19 initial inactive seconds and subsequent 25-second recharge intervals. Credit only observed grants; do not issue manual activation actions.
First readiness is 25 seconds after deployment; subsequent cycles include 25 active and 35 inactive seconds. Ordinary coverage remains the baseline.
First readiness is 30 seconds after deployment; subsequent cycles include 20 active and 30 inactive seconds.
First activation requires 40 inactive seconds after its actual deployment. Later activations require 40 active plus 70 inactive seconds. Use supported arts conversion only.
Allow supported automatic enhanced hits; do not assume highest-defense targeting.
No unsupported self-heal, guardian healing, mitigation aura, resistance reduction or stat talent is credited.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Establish upper interception at column 5 and lower interception at column 3, support the first upper duel with a separated cheap caster, and replace the damaged opening defender before its survival becomes an economic dependency. Treat four-roadblock clearance and artillery destruction as independent, mandatory objectives. This is an untested conditional candidate; neither the opening nor full-stage acceptance is established.

revised_stage_understanding.artillery_exit: The supplied modeled route has 29 distance units and 73 seconds of waits. At speed 0.5 from a 3-second spawn, an uninterrupted traversal suggests approximately 134 seconds; this is a model calculation, not exact client timing.
revised_stage_understanding.current_model: Natural DP, skill recovery, fixed-point artillery projectiles and conditional retreat refunds follow the supplied model evidence.
revised_stage_understanding.facts: Coordinates are [row,col]. Civilians are neutral, ordinary operators neither attack nor block them, roadblocks detain them, and officers can attack them within 1.2.
revised_stage_understanding.feasibility_status: The opening is redesigned, but an acceptance-ready full-stage continuation has not been established. In particular, the proposed reinforcement economy, early enough lower civilian release and sufficient artillery damage remain unresolved.
revised_stage_understanding.unknown: Roadblock HP and defense, actual target ordering, exact client timing and the resulting complete artillery damage budget are not supplied.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.hypothesis: Separating the early upper blocker from the lower shell absorber, adding cheap upper damage, and replacing the damaged defender before professional treatment may preserve the opening economy. This does not establish that enough resources remain for timely civilian release and artillery destruction.

revised_tactical_requirements.clearance: Require an explicit, affordable artillery damage schedule before treating this candidate as executable for acceptance.
revised_tactical_requirements.execution_boundary: Action preconditions are review requirements, not newly invented simulator action types or automatic tactical branches. A failed precondition rejects the corresponding continuation.
revised_tactical_requirements.opening: Verify survival and zero leaks before accepting any downstream grant or handoff.
revised_tactical_requirements.protection: Require four observed roadblock destructions, zero protected-target deaths and two observed safe arrivals.

revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Reject the opening ledger. Check Fang's actual deployment cost, survival and automatic grant before any dependent reinforcement; do not preserve the later schedule by inventing income, refunds or automatic waiting.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: The opening should be rebuilt around surviving, spatially separated interception rather than preserving Vanilla's failed conditional income. A fresh defender bridge and delayed deployment recovery may preserve lower interception while Fang and GALLUS reduce the upper duel.
